pattern.description: The import job log keeps streaming: the progress bar jumps from 64% to 78% to 85% and new status lines ('Running Automap', 'Fetching mappings') are inserted at the top of the log, pushing earlier lines down.
pattern.why_premium: Live, specific progress (percent and named loader steps) lands on 'consolidation.', proving the import runs itself without the viewer having to read every line.

build_hint.gsap: Discrete timeline, no tweening: tl.set('.progress-fill', {scaleX: 0.78, transformOrigin: 'left'}).set('.progress-pct', {textContent: '78%'}, '<').add(() => prependLogRow('Running Automap')).add(() => prependLogRow('Fetching mappings'), '+=0.03').set('.progress-fill', {scaleX: 0.85}, '+=0.25').set('.progress-pct', {textContent: '85%'}, '<'); each prepend shifts the list down one row height instantly.
build_hint.remotion: Map frame to state: pct = frame < 8 ? 64 : frame < 16 ? 78 : 85; rows = log.slice(0, visibleCount(frame)) rendered newest first; progress width = pct percent; no interpolate or spring, values step.

notes: Screen-recorded job progress; all changes look like instant steps rather than eased motion. OCR for log lines was truncated (b03, b05-b09); text was read from the end frame. Pattern kept as ai_answer_stream for consistency with e015, though it is a status log rather than an AI answer.
